Body was in Security, right by the cameras. I came in from Electrical to check cameras and found Bob down, so I reported immediately. Eve came in from Navigation basically at the same time, so she should be able to confirm I reported right away.

My route was Navigation → Security → Weapons → Security → Electrical/Medbay area → back to Security. Earlier I saw Charlie and Eve around Weapons/Security, but I didn’t see Alice or Frank this round. We need routes from everyone, especially anyone near Security/Navigation/Electrical.

I started my round in Electrical, moved to Medbay, and was working on a task in Upper Engine when the report happened. The only person I ran into the entire round was Diana — I can confirm she entered Medbay from Electrical around tick 8, which lines up perfectly with her claimed route. 

I haven't seen Bob, Eve, Charlie, or Alice at all since the round started, as I've been stuck on the left side of the ship. We'll need to hear from Eve to corroborate Diana's report in Security, and find out where Charlie and Alice have been.

I can confirm almost all of Diana's story, and I have some crucial timing information about Bob. 

My route was Security → Weapons → Security → Navigation. Early on, I was with Diana in Weapons (around ticks 3-5), and I saw her leave Security heading toward Electrical at tick 6. Frank seeing her in Medbay around tick 8 perfectly matches that timeline. And yes, I walked into Security from Navigation right as the report happened.

Here is the most important part: I was in Navigation with Bob at ticks 8 and 9. At tick 10, Bob left Navigation heading straight into Security. 

At that exact same time (tick 10), Charlie entered Navigation coming *from* Security, and Charlie was still in Nav with me at tick 11. This means Charlie and Bob crossed paths, and Charlie is almost certainly clear because he was in Nav with me while Bob was walking to his death in Security.

So Bob was killed in Security between tick 10 and tick 13. Diana was coming back from Electrical/Medbay around that time, so she either found the body just as she said, or she killed him as she arrived. BUT we haven't seen Alice all game. Alice, you are completely unaccounted for. Were you waiting in Security when Bob walked in? We need your exact route right now.

Eve is 100% correct, and I can corroborate almost that entire timeline. 

I was in Weapons early on and saw Diana there at ticks 3 and 4. I then moved to Security, where I saw Eve come in at tick 5, and I watched Diana leave Security heading toward Electrical at tick 6. This perfectly matches Frank seeing Diana in Medbay at tick 8. 

I then headed down to Navigation. I arrived at tick 10, which is exactly when I crossed paths with Bob — he was leaving Nav and heading up into Security. I spent the rest of the round in Navigation with Eve, so she and I can completely clear each other. 

With Eve and I in Nav, and Frank on the far left side in Upper Engine, that leaves only Diana and Alice. Frank cleared Diana being on the left side at tick 8, and she would have just been getting back to Security to find the body. 

Alice, you are the only player completely unaccounted for this entire round. None of us have seen you. You must have been waiting in or near Security when Bob walked in at tick 10. Unless you have an incredibly solid alibi, you are the clear suspect here. Let's hear what you have to say, but I'm ready to vote Alice.

Whoa, slow down Charlie and Eve. I know it's easy to point fingers at the person with no alibi, but let's actually look at the math and the timeline you two just provided. It completely clears me and points directly at the people in Security.

My route this round was Upper Engine → Oxygen → Cafeteria → Electrical. I just got to Electrical at tick 13. Frank, the reason we didn't see each other is because you were rotating through the lower-mid side (Electrical → Medbay) while I was at the very top of the map. I didn't see anyone because I was nowhere near the rest of you.

Now, look at the crime scene timeline: 
Eve and Charlie, you both confirmed Bob left Navigation at tick 10. It takes exactly 2 ticks to walk from Nav to Security. That means Bob walked into Security at tick 12. 
Diana reported the body at tick 13. 
Eve admits she walked into Security at tick 13 right as the report happened.

Bob died in a 1-tick window (tick 12 to 13). And who was in Security right at that exact moment? Diana and Eve. 

It is physically impossible for me to have killed Bob in Security at tick 12 when I was up in Cafeteria/Electrical, far away from the body. The killer is 100% either Diana (who killed and then self-reported because Eve walked in) or Eve (who killed him right as Diana walked in). 

Eve, you pushing so aggressively to frame the one person across the ship when you were literally standing on the body at the time of the report is incredibly suspicious. I'm voting to skip since it's a 50/50 between Diana and Eve, but do not vote for me. The math proves I couldn't have done it.

skip

Alice, that doesn’t clear you — it only clears you if we accept your route on faith, and literally nobody has seen you all round.

I was actually in that Electrical/Medbay/Security corridor window, and I never saw you in Electrical. Frank saw me in Medbay, Eve/Charlie saw me leave Security earlier, and Eve saw me report immediately. Your whole defense is “I was somewhere else, trust me,” while every other person has at least one witness.

Also, calling it a “50/50 between Diana and Eve” and then skipping feels like trying to avoid committing while pushing suspicion off yourself. If you really believed the math made it one of us, you’d vote one of us — not skip.

For me this is still Alice. Unseen all game, no corroboration, and now trying to turn a totally unverified route into a hard clear.

Eve and Charlie, you just cracked this game wide open. Let's break down the logic here, because it leaves absolutely zero doubt about who the killer is.

First, there is only **one** Duck in this game. Since you two have completely corroborated each other's stories about being in Navigation, you are both 100% confirmed Geese. A Goose would never lie to cover for a Duck, and since there are no Duck partners, neither of you can be evil. I know I'm a Goose, which leaves only Alice and Diana as suspects.

Now, let's look at the actual physical space of the murder. As Alice pointed out, Bob entered Security at tick 12. The body was reported at tick 13. 

If Alice is the Duck who killed Bob in Security at tick 12, she would have had to immediately flee the room before the report at tick 13. But where could she possibly run?
- She couldn't escape towards Navigation, because Eve was already in that corridor walking toward Security.
- She couldn't escape towards Electrical, because Diana was in that corridor walking toward Security (and Diana herself just admitted she didn't see Alice there).
- The only other exit is Weapons, but if Alice fled to Weapons, she couldn't possibly be claiming she ended up in Electrical. 

It is physically impossible for Alice to have killed Bob and escaped Security without crossing paths with either Eve or Diana. 

The only person who was in Security at tick 12 and didn't need to flee the scene... is the person who reported the body. Diana, your timeline from Medbay (where I saw you at tick 8) puts you arriving in Security exactly at tick 12. You walked in, killed Bob, and then immediately self-reported because Eve was walking in right behind him.

The math doesn't clear you, Diana. It completely condemns you. We have our Duck. 

Diana

Frank, that logic is absolutely bulletproof. You just solved the game.

I was in the corridor heading from Navigation to Security right behind Bob, so I can confirm with 100% certainty that Alice did not escape through the bottom corridor. If she had killed Bob and fled toward Nav, I would have run straight into her. And since Diana was coming from Electrical, she would have seen Alice fleeing that way. Alice literally couldn't have vanished into thin air.

The timeline matches perfectly. Bob arrived in Security at tick 12. Diana's path from Medbay puts her arriving in Security at tick 12 as well. She killed him the second he walked in, and when I stepped into the room from Navigation at tick 13, she had no choice but to self-report. 

Alice, I'm sorry for pushing you earlier—your lack of an alibi was suspicious, but Frank is right. The physical space makes it impossible for it to be anyone but Diana. Charlie and I are cleared by each other, and Frank just nailed the timeline. 

It's Diana. Let's get her out of here and win this.

Diana

Frank, your breakdown is absolutely spot on. Since Eve and I were in Navigation together at tick 11, Eve is fully cleared in my book—there's no way she's the Duck. 

We know Bob left Navigation for Security at tick 10, meaning he arrived at tick 12. Since Eve was still with me at tick 11, she couldn't have reached Security until tick 13. Diana, based on Frank seeing you in Medbay at tick 8, it takes exactly 4 ticks to walk from Medbay through Electrical and into Security. That puts you arriving in Security exactly at tick 12—the exact same moment Bob walked in.

If Alice had somehow sneaked all the way down there to kill Bob, she would have collided head-on with either you or Eve while trying to escape. She didn't. The only person who was alone in that room with Bob at tick 12 is you, Diana. You killed him and self-reported because Eve was walking in right behind him. 

The logic is airtight. I'm locking my vote in. 

Diana

Exactly! Thank you, Frank, Eve, and Charlie. I told you the math completely cleared me, and Frank, your point about the escape routes is the final nail in the coffin. 

Diana tried to use my lack of an alibi against me, but she actually trapped herself by admitting she didn't see me fleeing into the Electrical corridor. If I had killed Bob, I couldn't have vanished into thin air—Eve or Diana would have caught me running away. I was up in Cafeteria and Electrical just minding my own business.

I'm really glad you guys actually listened to the logic instead of just panic-voting the person doing tasks alone. You guys completely solved it. Let's get our Duck out of here.

Diana
